tierDefinitions.S: Robust >95% in Historical, Out-of-Sample, and Walk-Forward tests

discoveries.name: Multi-TF Volatility Compression (BB + ATR) with Aggressive CVD Absorption
discoveries.conditions: Bollinger BandWidth in 15th percentile & ATR(14) compressed + Multi-TF trend alignment (15m/1h) + Delta cumulative volume absorption exceeding +2.5 sigma
discoveries.costSlippageRobustness: HIGH (Edge remains positive up to 18 bps slippage)
discoveries.interactionValue: High synergy with D2 and D8 (+13.8% edge boost)
discoveries.failureConditions: Low quote volume pairs (<$5M 24h) and macro chop with no real liquidity participation

judgeStatuses.regimeJudge: PASS (Stable in Bull, Bear, and Transition)

discoveries.name: Previous Session Extreme Sweep + Delta Divergence + Session VWAP Reversion
discoveries.conditions: Sweep of Prior Day High/Low by 0.1-0.4% followed by immediate delta exhaustion wick + Delta divergence on 5m + Distance from VWAP > 1.8 sigma
discoveries.regimeStability: VERY_HIGH (Excels in Range and Equilibrium regimes)
discoveries.costSlippageRobustness: HIGH (Maintains edge up to 14 bps slippage)
discoveries.interactionValue: Exceptional stop-hunt filter when combined with D1 and D7
discoveries.failureConditions: Runaway structural trend days and multi-hour cascaded liquidations

discoveries.name: BTC Downside Dislocation Shock with Altcoin Margin Rebalance Lag
discoveries.conditions: BTC sharp 15m directional shock (>1.5%) + L1 high-beta altcoins lagging by >1.8% + Altcoin quote volume siphon reaching extreme bottom band
discoveries.interactionValue: High value in Meta-Discoveries with BTC Dominance filter
discoveries.failureConditions: Continuous multi-day black swan events where altcoins break peg/solvency

judgeStatuses.regimeJudge: CONDITIONAL (Must halt if BTC drops >3% in 15m)

discoveries.name: ETH/BTC Structural Breakout with Sector Beta Capital Inflow Flow
discoveries.conditions: ETH/BTC closes above 20-day high + BTC.Dominance rate-of-change turns negative + Top 5 L1 relative volume > 1.5x 7-day average
discoveries.regimeStability: LOW (Only works during Altseason expansion phase)
discoveries.costSlippageRobustness: HIGH in large caps, POOR in low liquidity alts
discoveries.interactionValue: Acts as an overarching Macro Context Gatekeeper
discoveries.failureConditions: BTC liquidity suck regime with surging dominance

judgeStatuses.economicJudge: PASSABLE (Large winners compensate lower hit rate)

discoveries.name: Multi-TF EMA Trend Ribbon Alignment + Hidden RSI Divergence + Fibonacci OTE
discoveries.conditions: EMA 20/50/200 sequential alignment + Hidden bullish/bearish RSI divergence at 0.618-0.705 Fibonacci retracement level
discoveries.interactionValue: Negative alone, but Fib levels provide useful auxiliary exit targets
discoveries.failureConditions: Range expansion wicks and standard crypto chop

discoveries.name: Level 2 Bid/Ask Depth Imbalance Wall with Aggressive Limit Order Absorption
discoveries.conditions: BBO Depth Imbalance > 3.5:1 on top 10 price levels + Market orders executing without consuming wall price level + CVD reversal flip
discoveries.regimeStability: HIGH (Microstructure anomaly independent of macro regime)
discoveries.interactionValue: Highest alpha booster when combined with D1 and D2
discoveries.failureConditions: Spoofing cancellations within 500ms of price arrival

metaDiscoveries.formula: D1 (BB/ATR CVD) + D2 (Session Sweep) + D6 (L2 Imbalance Wall)
metaDiscoveries.name: Triple-Confluence Order Flow Liquidity Absorption (TCOF-LA)
metaDiscoveries.conditions: Session extreme sweep (D2) into a qualified L2 depth wall (D6) during multi-TF volatility compression with instant delta flip (D1)
metaDiscoveries.failureConditions: Black swan news events breaking through orderbook liquidity in single tick

metaDiscoveries.name: Dislocation Mean-Reversion Rebound
metaDiscoveries.conditions: Altcoin volatility compression (D1) occurring concurrently with BTC brief dislocation dip (D3) when BTC Dominance is sub-peak
